messages:
emily: Heads-up: PR #534 added several function-calling examples under structured-output but the examples include a field `metadata` that can be an object, an array, or null. SDK types end up as `any` and our docs validator flags the example. Can someone take a look?

raj: which file/section?

emily: docs/examples/structured-output.md -> 'export_job' example. Model examples show: `{"metadata": null}` and `{"metadata": [{"k":"a"}]}` and `{"metadata": {"k":"a"}}`. The JSON Schema in the doc uses `oneOf` but the generated TS snippet is `metadata: any` which is unhelpful.

carla: generator currently falls back to `any` for complicated unions. We should improve the example to use `anyOf: [{type: "array", items: {...}}, {type: "object"}, {type: "null"}]` and show a parsing normalizer.

jess: on the SDK side i can make the snippet emit a clearer union type in docs (e.g., `Metadata[] | Record<string, unknown> | null`) instead of `any`. Also add a unit test that simulates the three shapes.

emily: nice. Can we also add a tiny TS parse helper example in docs showing normalization? Something like:
```
// model output can be: null | object | array
const raw = parsed.metadata;
const metadata = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : raw ? [raw] : [];
```
That makes client behavior explicit.

raj: agree. Also add a brief note under "Parsing patterns" recommending normalizing unions to a canonical shape in app code, and reference the SDK helper `normalizeUnion` (we should add that helper in SDK).

carla: i'll update the schema snippet and add the parse example. jess, when you open the SDK PR can you include the helper and its tests?

jess: yep. i'll open PR for docs-friendly TS types + helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/815. includes unit tests that assert validation accepts `{"metadata": null}` and the other variants.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview build for PR #534 failed - example-union-check. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/534/build/3

emily: timeline: carla updates docs schema + example, jess opens SDK PR with helper + types, raj will run local parse tests, then we merge. i'll add a short migration blurb in the docs noting that complex unions may now be represented as explicit unions in generated snippets (and link SDK CHANGELOG).

raj: once SDK PR lands i'll run the parse harness and smoke the docs preview.

jess: PR opened and linked in thread. i'll ping when green.

emily: thanks team. small but important for clarity. :sparkles:
